newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures steady to higher at close.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures steady to higher at close.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures closed steady to slightly higher in moderate trade on some late buying interest in line with firmer Japanese prices, brokers said on Wednesday.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on a lack of fresh factors, but prices were marked up slightly in the afternoon in sympathy with higher prices in Tokyo and Kobe. Volume was moderate," a local broker said.
"The market was slightly higher in the afternoon but activity was limited by a lack of foreign inquiries and silent ring sessions," another broker said.
At 0945 GMT, March RSS3 rose 1.25 cents to 123.75 U.S. cents a kg.
October/December RSS1 rose half a cent to 181.25 Singapore cents (US$1.28) a kg.
April TSR20 was unchanged from Tuesday's settlement of 171.00 Singapore cents (US$1.21) a kg.
